cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery under either general or neuraxial anesthesia were enrolled from a national health insurance database.
finding: Women who underwent cesarean delivery under general anesthesia had a significantly higher risk of new-onset postpartum depression within 90 days compared with those under neuraxial anesthesia.
mod_finding: Women undergoing cesarean delivery with general anesthesia had a higher risk of postpartum depression within 90 days compared to those with neuraxial anesthesia.
